title: Djembe Circle (West Africa Instrumental)
style: West African djembe percussion pure instrumental dunun bass drums kenkeni bell 92bpm traditional Guinea Senegal polyrhythm no vocals ceremonial energetic dance circle textural
lyrics:
[Instrumental — djembe lead, dunun bass drums, kenkeni bell]

[Opening — single djembe call]

[Dunun joins — bass foundation]

[Kenkeni bell — cross-rhythm pattern]

[Full circle — all percussion layers]

[Solo break — djembe improvisation]

[Return — full ensemble]

[Fade — djembe alone]
